objective: Audit the active goal fullITA/MHA execution plus larger paged attention / KV-cache scale-up against concrete artifacts before deciding whether the goal is complete.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.notes: The 8-page x 16-slot / 128 logical-slot KV-cache harness passes CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence for 1x1, 64x1, 1x64, and 256x1.
The full PULP ITA top module is instantiated in the repo overlay with reduced 16x16 parameters and passes CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence for 1x1, 32x1, and 1x32.

Current evidence covers larger paged KV-cache behavior and full ITA/MHA separately. It does not yet combine attention score / softmax-style selection with paged KV lookup in one paged-attention-like RTL harness.
All listed compares use coverage-output equivalence and record zero coverage-output mismatches.

completion_decision.reason: The active goal has strong evidence for larger KV-cache scale-up and scoped full ITA/MHA execution, but the paged-attention portion remains a gap because the larger KV-cache harness is not a combined paged-attention datapath.
